name: GlzIconButton
semanticRole: Execute a compact action represented primarily by one recognizable symbol.

material.rule: Quiet is preferred inside ordinary toolbars; Glaze is reserved for floating controls; danger is only for genuinely destructive actions.

input.keyboard: Enter or Space activates once; ambiguous icon actions expose an accessible name and tooltip without requiring hover.
input.focus: Focus ring surrounds the hit target rather than only the glyph.
input.hover: Hover may reveal a tooltip and restrained state layer; no essential information depends on hover.
input.press: Immediate state layer/compression feedback; no icon jump or relayout.
input.selection: Selected icon buttons use at least two cues such as tint plus filled symbol or selection indicator.

accessibility.name: Every icon-only control has an explicit accessible action name; ambiguous, destructive, or shortcut actions also expose a concise tooltip such as Share project.
accessibility.state: Disabled, selected, loading, and error state are programmatically exposed when applicable.
accessibility.value: No value for ordinary icon actions; toggle-like icon actions expose checked/pressed state rather than encoding value in color.
accessibility.keyboard: Keyboard activation and tooltip discoverability are supported without pointer hover.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus covers the full target and remains stronger than or equal to hover discoverability.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors caused by the action are announced through the associated status/error region.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Remove decorative icon morph/scale unless the morph is required to explain state; use direct state swap or short crossfade.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen target boundary, selected indicator, and focus ring.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform button/focus colors and preserve selected/danger meaning with shape, fill, or label.
accessibility.largeText: Tooltip text scales and wraps; target size remains usable.

fallbacks.forcedColors: Platform colors and explicit selected/destructive semantics.
fallbacks.performance: Remove optional material blur and decorative shadow first.

content.overflow: The control itself never clips the semantic symbol; tooltip handles longer action names.
content.localization: Accessible name and tooltip localize independently of the fixed icon geometry.
content.rtl: Directional symbols mirror when their action direction mirrors; non-directional symbols retain orientation.

criteria: Glyph occupies an optically balanced portion of the container without crowding.
Selected and danger states are readable without color-only cues.
Tooltip relationship is clear without making every icon permanently labeled.
Floating Glaze variant remains restrained and does not turn ordinary toolbars into glass clusters.
